# Third-party source

`FlowFormerPlusPlus/` is an unmodified clone of the official
`XiaoyuShi97/FlowFormerPlusPlus` repository.

- Upstream: https://github.com/XiaoyuShi97/FlowFormerPlusPlus
- Commit: `c33de90f35af3fac1a55de6eac58036dd8ffb3b3`
- License: Apache-2.0 (see the upstream README)

Model checkpoints are not redistributed and remain ignored by the parent
project. Download an official checkpoint separately into
`FlowFormerPlusPlus/checkpoints/`.
